Specialized required courses An Introduction to Jurisprudence Constitutional Law Principles of Civil Law1 Principles of Civil Law2 Chinese Legal History Commercial Law (Introduction, Corporation Law And Partnership Law) General Principles of Criminal Law Special Principles of Criminal Law Civil Procedure Law Intellectual Property Law Criminal Procedure Law Survey of Economic Law Elements of Jurisprudence Administrative Law And Procedure Public International Law Private International Law International Economic Law Public required courses Fundamentals of Computer Applications An Introduction to Chinese Civilization An Introduction to Western Civilization Chinese-1 Chinses-2 General Introduction to China 2.Period of Study After formal admission, students will have a full-time study for 4 years in China University of Political Science and Law (CUPL). 3. Tuition and Application Fee of the Preparatory Courses Tuition is 20,000 RMB per year; application fee is 660 RMB. Those whose Chinese proficiency is under HSK level 5,without receiving preparatory courses and intend to directly enter bachelor's degree studyneed to pay the application service fee 10,000 RMB (including the related costs used for: Chinese courses, major courses, guidance to studying abroad, selection of majors and completion of relevant procedures etc.). 4. Scholarship Foreign students will obtain "the scholarship for freshmen", once they are admitted by our university as freshmen. 5. Accommodations Students can live in the students’ apartments arranged by the School of International Education, or solve accommodations by themselves.

duration.text: The Law at China University of Political Science and Law is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

materials.text: 1. Application Form for Chinese Government Scholarship (in Chinese or English).2. Copy of Passport Home Page. Applicant shall submit a clear scanned copy of his/her ordinary passport with validity later than the 31st March 2026. If the validity of the current passport does not meet the requirement, please renew the passport before submitting the application.3. Diploma and certificate of highest education (notarized photocopy). Prospective diploma winners shall submit the certificate of expected graduation or student status issued by his/her university; Those who have graduated, must submit the official diploma, i.e., the original copy of graduation certificate and degree certificate written in Chinese or English. Diploma mentioned above in languages other than Chinese or English must be attached with notarization/legalization/Apostille accordingly (please check example in appendix 2).4. Academic transcripts. Those who apply for undergraduate program, must submit the full transcript of high school; Those who apply for Master’s program, must submit full transcript of bachelor’s study; Those who apply for PhD’s program, must submit full transcript of bachelor’s and Master’s study. These transcripts shall be issued and sealed by the attending university’s academic affairs office, graduate school, or student management department. They can be in Chinese or English, but must be attached with notarized English translations if they are in foreign languages other than English;5. Language qualification certificates. Applicants for Chinese-taught programs must submit valid HSK reports in accordance with the corresponding Chinese proficiency requirements. Applicants for other language-taught programs shall provide relevant language proficiency certificates according to the universities’ requirements, like IELTS or TOFEL report6. A Study Plan or Research Proposal, written in Chinese or English, minimum of 200 words for undergraduates, 1000 words for postgraduates;7. Recommendation letters. Applicants for postgraduate programs must submit two letters of recommendation written in Chinese or English from professors or associate professors;8. Applicants under the age of 18 should submit the valid documents of their legal guardians in China;9. Applicants planning to stay in China for more than 6 months must submit a photocopy of the Foreigner Physical Examination Form completed in English (the original copy should be kept by the applicant. The form is designed by the Chinese quarantine authority and can be obtained from the dispatching authority. The physical examinations must cover all the items listed in the Foreigner Physical Examination Form. Incomplete records or those without the signature of the attending physician, the official stamp of the hospital or a sealed photograph of the applicants are invalid. Please select the appropriate time to take physical examination as the result is valid for only 6 months.10. Non-criminal record report. The applicant shall submit a valid certificate of Non-Criminal Record issued by the local public security authority, usually issued within 6 months prior to the submission date of the application.11. Those who apply for undergraduate program, must submit birth certificate. Notarized translation is needed if the document is in foreign languages other than English or Chinese;Reminder:1. For documents in languages other than Chinese and English, please provide notarized English translation.2. All uploaded supporting documents must be clear, authentic and valid. Applicants are recommended to use professional device to scan the relevant documents. Applicants shall bear the consequences caused by unclear or unidentifiable uploaded materials.

requirements.text: 1. Applicants must be a citizen of a country other than the People’s Republic of China, and be in good health.2. Must come from jointly build the Belt and Road countries3. The requirements for applicants’ degree and age are that applicants must:- be a high school graduate and no more than 25 when applying for the undergraduate programs;- be a bachelor’s degree holder and no more than 35 when applying for the master’s programs;- be a master’s degree holder and no more than 40 when applying for the doctoral programs.4. Language requirements:Applicants to the Chinese Teaching undergraduate program are only eligible to apply if their Chinese language proficiency is at least HSK3; applicants to postgraduate program are only eligible to apply if their Chinese language proficiency is at least HSK4. Applicants to the English Teaching program are required to provide proof of English language proficiency.5. Applicants should fulfill the admission requirements for both academic ability, language ability and other aspects required by the university.
